title: Agent
description: The identity axis: who this agent is, and which keys speak for it. Answers the merchant's first question — should I be talking to this thing at all — independently of what the user authorised it to do.

id.description: Stable identifier for the agent. What a registry is keyed by, and what a mandate's agent key is expected to belong to.

name.description: Human-readable name of the agent, as shown to a user on the Trusted Surface.

operator.description: The organisation that operates this agent and is accountable for it. Distinct from the agent itself: one operator may run many agents.

keys.description: Public keys that speak for this agent. A list rather than a single key so that rotation does not require a new identity.
